effects: Run by delegatecall from the Safe, it overwrites the Safe proxy's singleton (storage slot 0) with the fixed SAFE_SINGLETON, 0x41675C09…461a (Safe v1.4.1 on mainnet). From then on that code controls the Safe.
It moves no tokens or ETH, sets no approvals and is not payable.
formats.shown: "Migrate Safe" and the migration contract address. Nothing says the Safe's implementation is replaced, or by which version or address.

findings.title: migrateSingleton intent "Migrate Safe" does not say the Safe's code is replaced, or with which version.
findings.evidence: SafeMigration.sol migrateSingleton(): `singleton = SAFE_SINGLETON;`. Descriptor: "intent": "Migrate Safe". The only field is `@.to` 'Migration contract'. The target is fixed per deployment: constructor arg safeSingleton 0x41675C099F32341bf84BFc5382aF534df5C7461a, contract name SafeMigration-1.4.1.
findings.fix: Use an intent like "Upgrade Safe implementation to v1.4.1" and label the field "Migration contract (v1.4.1)".

findings.title: migrateSingleton: the new singleton address is an immutable, not calldata, so no field can show it.
findings.evidence: SafeMigration.sol: `address public immutable SAFE_SINGLETON;`, set in the constructor. The function has no parameters.
findings.fix: Name the target version in the intent or label, since the address cannot be read from calldata.

effects: Run by delegatecall from the Safe, it overwrites the Safe's singleton with the fixed SAFE_SINGLETON (Safe v1.4.1). Its events say ChangedMasterCopy.

It calls the Safe's own setFallbackHandler with the fixed SAFE_FALLBACK_HANDLER (0xfd0732Dc…Ec99). This replaces whatever fallback handler the Safe had, which changes how the Safe answers unknown calls such as EIP-1271 signature checks and token callbacks.
It moves no tokens or ETH, sets no approvals and is not payable.
formats.shown: "Migrate Safe" and the migration contract address. This is the same screen as migrateSingleton, and nothing mentions the fallback handler being replaced.

findings.title: migrateWithFallbackHandler replaces the Safe's fallback handler, but its screen is the same as migrateSingleton's.
findings.evidence: SafeMigration.sol migrateWithFallbackHandler(): `migrateSingleton(); ISafe(address(this)).setFallbackHandler(SAFE_FALLBACK_HANDLER);`. Descriptor: "intent": "Migrate Safe", exactly as in migrateSingleton(). The only field is `@.to`. Any existing handler, for example a custom one with signature or domain verifiers, is overwritten without notice.
findings.fix: Use an intent like "Upgrade Safe to v1.4.1 and replace fallback handler".

findings.title: migrateWithFallbackHandler: the new singleton and fallback handler addresses are immutables, not calldata.
findings.evidence: SafeMigration.sol: `SAFE_SINGLETON` and `SAFE_FALLBACK_HANDLER` are immutable constructor values. The function has no parameters.
findings.fix: Name the version and the handler change in the intent.

effects: Run by delegatecall from the Safe, it overwrites the Safe's singleton with the fixed SAFE_L2_SINGLETON, 0x29fcB43b…C762 (SafeL2 v1.4.1). This happens on any chain, mainnet included.
It moves no tokens or ETH, sets no approvals and is not payable.
formats.shown: "Migrate Safe L2" and the migration contract address. Nothing says the implementation is replaced by the SafeL2 v1.4.1 singleton.

findings.title: migrateL2Singleton intent "Migrate Safe L2" reads as migrating an L2 Safe, not switching to the L2 singleton.
findings.evidence: SafeMigration.sol migrateL2Singleton(): `singleton = SAFE_L2_SINGLETON;`. Descriptor: "intent": "Migrate Safe L2". It works the same on every chain, and the version is not named.
findings.fix: Use an intent like "Upgrade Safe implementation to SafeL2 v1.4.1".

findings.title: migrateL2Singleton: the new singleton address is an immutable, not calldata, so no field can show it.
findings.evidence: SafeMigration.sol: `address public immutable SAFE_L2_SINGLETON;`, set in the constructor.
findings.fix: Name the target in the intent or label.

effects: Run by delegatecall from the Safe, it overwrites the Safe's singleton with the fixed SAFE_L2_SINGLETON (SafeL2 v1.4.1). Its events say ChangedMasterCopy.
It calls the Safe's own setFallbackHandler with the fixed SAFE_FALLBACK_HANDLER (0xfd0732Dc…Ec99), replacing the existing fallback handler.
It moves no tokens or ETH, sets no approvals and is not payable.
formats.shown: "Migrate Safe L2" and the migration contract address. This is the same screen as migrateL2Singleton, and nothing mentions the fallback handler being replaced.

findings.title: migrateL2WithFallbackHandler replaces the Safe's fallback handler, but its screen is the same as migrateL2Singleton's.

findings.title: migrateL2WithFallbackHandler intent "Migrate Safe L2" does not name the L2 singleton or the version.
findings.fix: Name SafeL2 v1.4.1 in the intent.
